name: Girl in Black
source:
A girl in black who occasionally appears in Paradise. She's a phantom-like being who shows up when least expected, but details such as her name, role, and objective are completely unknown.

[translated from [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/fairy/index.html]official website[/url]]
